coverage: Federal offices in every state, general elections with vote counts: President by state 1976–2024, U.S. Senate 1976–2026, U.S. House 2002–2026. For earlier House and Senate elections back to 1968 the member seated is shown without a vote count. Federal primaries 2002–2022. Georgia before 2016: 1988–2015 (statewide, federal, legislative and judicial contests and ballot questions by county, with primaries and runoffs; county and city contests where the state's archive holds them). Not on file yet: Georgia's results before 2000 (the Secretary of State's site turns crawlers away, so its 1988–2015 files are read when downloaded by hand; earlier years exist only in printed registers), presidential results by state for 1968 and 1972, and city-run elections, which were never reported to the state and are added as each city's or county's own records are found.
